subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should ordered fallback verification use a dedicated fallback-test command, be folded into the broader `models status --probe --all` work, or expose both through one shared diagnostic backend?
rationale: The feature gap is clear, but the permanent public command shape and semantic distinction between auth health, per-model health, and actual fallback-chain execution require maintainer intent.

options.title: Shared backend, focused commands
options.body: Implement one chain-aware diagnostic backend with a canonical CLI fallback-test command and an optional thin `/models test-fallback` wrapper.

options.title: Fold into status probe
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63145 the canonical surface and extend `models status --probe --all` to report ordered fallback-chain semantics as well as per-model health.

options.title: Defer slash surface
options.body: Implement only CLI per-model health first and retain this issue for a later decision on whether chat-based fallback testing is worth the extra command surface.

recommendation.title: Shared backend, focused commands
recommendation.body: Implement one chain-aware diagnostic backend with a canonical CLI fallback-test command and an optional thin `/models test-fallback` wrapper.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue already contains this reviewer’s detailed distinction between current auth probing and the requested fallback-chain behavior, alongside recent history in both fallback and status paths.
